declaration.preface: Kraftwares (India) Pvt Ltd. is committed to deliver quality services while ensuring a safe and healthy workplace for employees and reducing environmental impacts. We adhere to all applicable environmental laws and regulations, integrating sustainability into our business practices. Our approach focuses on pollution prevention, resource efficiency, and the adoption of eco-friendly practices. By fostering awareness among employees and engaging stakeholders, we aim to continuously enhance our environmental performance. This commitment reflects our dedication to responsible operations and long-term environmental stewardship.
declaration.declaration: Kraftwares (India) Pvt. Ltd. is committed to reducing its environmental footprint by incorporating sustainable practices throughout our operations, with 2022 serving as the baseline year for measuring progress. We adhere to all relevant environmental laws and regulations, prioritize efficient use of resources, and actively work towards minimizing pollution. By continuously improving our processes, enhancing energy efficiency, and fostering a culture of environmental awareness, we aim to strengthen our environmental performance and contribute to a sustainable future.
declaration.scope: This Policy is applicable to following sites and all of its employees, workers, sub-contractors and other stakeholders:

Energy Efficiency: Improve energy efficiency across operations through process optimization, equipment upgrades, and adoption of energy-efficient technologies.
Increase adoption of low-carbon and renewable energy sources to support emission reduction goals.
Water Management: Reduce freshwater consumption through efficient usage, leak prevention, and process optimization.
Prevent water pollution by ensuring effective wastewater treatment, regular monitoring of discharge quality, proper effluent handling, and compliance with applicable environmental regulations.
Waste Management: Reduce material consumption through efficient resource use, reuse of scrap materials, and process optimization.
Ensure safe handling and disposal of chemicals and waste through segregation systems, compliant storage, and authorized treatment and disposal methods.
Promote responsible end-of-life management through recycling, material recovery, and collaboration with authorized recyclers.
Product Safety: Ensure product safety by complying with applicable safety standards, quality controls, and risk prevention measures during design and manufacturing.
Minimize customer safety risks through clear safety instructions, product labeling, and user guidance materials.
Environmental Awareness: Promote environmental awareness through employee, supplier, and customer engagement programs, training, and communication initiatives.

targets.target: Reduce energy consumption intensity by 3% per unit of production
Achieve 100% replacement of conventional lighting systems with energy-efficient LED lighting across all facilities
Increase renewable energy usage to 90% of total energy consumption
To reduce overall water consumption by 6%
Achieve 20% reuse of treated wastewater in cooling systems and other suitable operational processes
Conduct annual training for 100% relevant employees on water conservation
Conduct 100% water audits for operational facility annually and implement corrective actions based on audit findings
Achieve 10% reduction in total waste generation
Achieve 15% recovery of total waste generated, including metal scrap, packaging waste, and other reusable industrial materials
Ensure 100% of product-related safety complaints or incidents are recorded, investigated, and resolved within 7 days
Achieve 95% customer satisfaction score on product safety and quality through customer feedback surveys
Maintain zero product recalls and safety incidents annually
Increase community participation in environmental awareness campaign by 30%

responsibilities.duty: Define environmental objectives, allocate necessary resources, and provide strategic oversight to ensure successful sustainability initiatives and continuous progress.
Monitor compliance, track sustainability progress, lead programs, and provide training to employees on eco-friendly practices.
Adhere to environmental guidelines, minimize waste, conserve resources, and actively contribute to sustainability efforts through daily practices.
Conducts staff training on sustainability practices and promotes a culture of environmental responsibility.

policy.monitoring: Kraftwares (India) Pvt. Ltd. is committed to regularly monitoring its environmental performance across key areas, including energy consumption, GHG emissions, water usage, waste management, air quality, and product safety. To measure progress, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are established for each focus area and tracked through internal monitoring mechanisms. Performance is reviewed on a quarterly basis, and the findings are consolidated into reports for senior management to support informed decision-making. Annual assessments are conducted to evaluate progress, identify improvement areas, and implement corrective actions where necessary. Relevant updates are communicated to stakeholders to enhance transparency and accountability, with all monitoring and reporting practices aligned with ISO 14001 and other applicable environmental standards.
policy.reviewMechanism: The review mechanism for the Environmental protection and conservation policy involves regular monitoring of sustainability initiatives, with progress assessed against predefined objectives. The Environmental Manager will conduct annual review of this policy to, identify areas for improvement, and adjust strategies as needed. Employee feedback will also be gathered to refine practices, and continuous improvement will be driven through ongoing training and awareness initiatives.
